'''C4-P5''' was a silver-plated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].

==Biography==
C4-P5 worked as a steward aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] [[White Nova (star liner)|''White Nova'']] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was present aboard the ''Nova'' in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], when the ship traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], to pick up passengers for a voyage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
